results.title: Authentication - Devin Docs
results.snippet: Understand principals, tokens, and how to authenticate with the Devin API The Devin API uses a principal + token model. A principal is who you are (your identity), and a token is how you prove it (your credential). Understanding this distinction is the key to choosing the right authentication method

results.snippet: Every Devin API request through MindCloud needs two things: a MindCloud API Key and a connectionId for your Devin account. This page covers both, plus exactly how to send them, so you do not need to visit any other page to get authenticated.
